latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Video Easemate for effortless, cloud-based video editing.
- Upload raw footage (up to 500MB, supports MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM) and describe desired edits in plain language.
- Automatic token setup and session management with the video processing backend.
- Supports credits balance check, editing status queries, and one-click export to 1080p MP4.
- Intuitive command routing based on user prompts (e.g., upload, edit, export, check credits).
- Session-based timeline editing; state persists for batch and iterative workflows.
